component_name: PART 001 - F1 front wing mounting bracket
steps: Map the user envelope (R05-R09) to the l_bracket parameters: base leg 120 mm along X, upright 65 mm along Z, width 70 mm along Y, base 12 mm, upright 10 mm thick.
Set the inner bend fillet to the user minimum of R5 (R12). Check it against DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN (>= 3 mm) and DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET (5/12 = 0.42 >= 0.2).

Place the 2 x Ø10 base holes (vehicle side, A07) as 1 row x 2 columns, and the 2 x Ø8 upright holes (front-wing side) as 1 row x 2 columns. Check GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE (>= 1.5 d) and clearance to the bend fillet.
Assign fastener designations to the user hole diameters (A10). The user diameters are kept. The STD-ISO273-MEDIUM mismatch is reported as advisory, not hidden.
Check feasibility and DFM in Python: minimum wall 10 mm >= 2 mm (DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN), hole edge distances and fillet ratios.
Build the parametric model in Fusion with the generator origin kept (R17). Apply the user pose (R18-R23) with R = Rz(60)*Ry(35)*Rx(15) (A09), then read the placement back.
Measure the geometry in Fusion: bounding box, thicknesses, hole diameters and positions, fillet radius, and mass with AL7075-T6.
Report the structural check as NOT_RUN, because no load case was given (A04).

leg_base_length.rationale: The user's overall length of 120 mm along local X. The base leg runs x = 0..120.

leg_upright_height.rationale: The user's support height of 65 mm along local Z, measured from the base bottom face z = 0.

bracket_width.rationale: The user's overall width of 70 mm along local Y, symmetric about y = 0.

bracket_thickness.rationale: The user's base thickness of 12 mm. This is well above the 2 mm minimum wall in DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN.

upright_thickness.rationale: The user's vertical support thickness of 10 mm. It is given explicitly because it differs from the 12 mm base thickness.

bend_inner_radius.rationale: The user minimum of R5. It meets the >= 3 mm end-mill rule and the fatigue ratio 5/12 = 0.42 >= 0.2. The generator sets the outer fillet to 5 + 12 = 17 mm.

base_hole_diameter.rationale: The user's Ø10 finished hole. It is kept as given, although it is the ISO 273 coarse clearance for M8, not the medium value of 9.0 (advisory STD-ISO273-MEDIUM).

base_hole_rows.rationale: The two base holes are set as one row across the width (1 x 2 = 2 holes, R10).

base_hole_cols.rationale: Two columns symmetric about y = 0 give the 2 holes of R10 and a lateral bolt spread against roll moments.

base_hole_x0.rationale: The row sits on the free part of the base, well clear of the bend fillet end at x = 15 (gap of 55 mm to the hole edge leaves room for the bolt head and tool). The distance to the free end x = 120 is 45 mm >= 15 mm (1.5 d).

base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: Ignored by the generator because there is only 1 row. Placeholder value only.

base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Holes at y = +/-18. Side edge distance is 35 - 18 = 17 mm >= 15 mm (1.5 x 10).

upright_hole_diameter.rationale: The user's Ø8 finished hole. It is kept as given, although it is a large clearance for M6 and not an ISO 273 medium value (advisory STD-ISO273-MEDIUM).

upright_hole_rows.rationale: One row across the width gives 1 x 2 = 2 holes (R11).

upright_hole_cols.rationale: Two columns symmetric about y = 0 for the front-wing interface.

upright_hole_z0.rationale: The distance to the top edge z = 65 is 20 mm >= 12 mm (1.5 x 8). The hole is 28 mm above the inner fillet end at z = 17, which leaves bolt-head and tool access.

upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Ignored by the generator because there is only 1 row. Placeholder value only.

upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Holes at y = +/-18, matching the base pattern. Side edge distance is 17 mm >= 12 mm (1.5 x 8).

design_inputs.base_mates_with: vehicle-side mounting structure (chassis/nose), base bottom face z=0 (A07)
design_inputs.upright_mates_with: front wing mounting pylon/interface, upright outer face x=0 (A07)

load_case.description: No load case was given by the user (M03/A04). Force and lever arm are set to 0 as a 'no load' marker, so STR-PLATE-BENDING is reported as NOT_RUN, not passed. The safety factor of 1.0 is a placeholder only and is not evaluated.

verification_plan: Fusion measurement: bounding box in the local frame is 120 x 70 x 65 mm (R05, R06, R09). Base thickness is 12 mm and upright thickness is 10 mm (R07, R08).
Fusion measurement: 2 x Ø10 base holes at x = 75, y = +/-18 and 2 x Ø8 upright holes at z = 45, y = +/-18. Count and diameters match R10 and R11.
Fusion measurement: inner bend fillet R5 is present (R12).
Rule check: DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN (10 mm >= 2 mm), DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN (5 >= 3), DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET (0.42 >= 0.2), GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE (min ratio 17/10 = 1.7 >= 1.5).
Rule check: STD-ISO273-MEDIUM is expected to give an ADVISORY mismatch for M8/Ø10 and M6/Ø8. The user diameters are retained (A10).
Placement read-back: the occurrence transform equals position (500, -250, 150) mm and R = Rz(60)*Ry(35)*Rx(15) (R18-R23, A09).
Mass from Fusion volume x 2810 kg/m3 (AL7075-T6, A02). Indicative only.
Hand calculation: STR-PLATE-BENDING is NOT_RUN because there is no load case (A04). No structural-safety claim is made (A01).

placement.rationale: The user-stated pose of the generator origin, applied as R = Rz(yaw)*Ry(pitch)*Rx(roll) per the project convention.

new_assumptions.text: Fastener designations: M8 for the Ø10 base holes and M6 for the Ø8 upright holes. The user's hole diameters are kept as the finished diameters.
new_assumptions.rationale: The generator requires a fastener string (the previous plan failed with base_fastener/upright_fastener = None). Ø10 is the ISO 273 coarse clearance for M8. Ø8 is the nearest usable clearance for M6. The user specified holes, not bolts (A05).
new_assumptions.impact: STD-ISO273-MEDIUM will flag an advisory mismatch. The bolt size and fit must be confirmed by the user before mating with real parts.

new_assumptions.text: The load case is entered as force 0 N and lever arm 0 mm with a placeholder safety factor of 1.0. This only signals 'no load defined'.
new_assumptions.rationale: The schema requires a load case, but no load was given and loads must not be invented (A04).
new_assumptions.impact: The structural check is NOT_RUN. Strength is unverified until the user supplies a load.
